title: The Kingdom of God
sourceBasis: World English Bible — 66-book Old and New Testament Scripture text already installed in Iron Sharpener
definition: The kingdom of God is God’s saving reign revealed in Christ, present among His people, and awaiting full public completion when Christ returns. It is not merely human politics, earthly power, or inward feeling.
summary: The kingdom of God is God’s saving reign revealed in Christ, present among His people, and awaiting full public completion when Christ returns. It is not merely human politics, earthly power, or inward feeling.
christFocus: Jesus Christ is the King who announces, embodies, secures, and will consummate the kingdom of God. Through Him, sinners are transferred from darkness into the kingdom of God’s beloved Son.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Jesus came proclaiming the kingdom of God. In Him, God’s reign broke into history with authority, mercy, healing, truth, judgment, and salvation.

The kingdom is already present where Christ reigns by His Word and Spirit, yet it is not yet seen in final fullness. Believers live under Christ’s rule while awaiting the day when every enemy is put under His feet.

The kingdom must not be reduced to earthly politics or human power. Jesus declared that His kingdom is not from this world. It advances through Gospel proclamation, discipleship, holiness, suffering, and witness.

When Christ returns, the kingdom will be openly revealed in glory. The kingdoms of the world will become the kingdom of the Lord and of His Christ.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content:
People often look for ultimate hope in earthly governments, movements, leaders, or cultural victories. The kingdom of God lifts hope higher than human power.

This doctrine teaches believers to live under Christ’s reign now. Obedience, mission, justice, mercy, worship, and endurance flow from belonging to the King whose kingdom cannot fail.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Seek first the kingdom of God. Submit your priorities, fears, loyalties, and ambitions to Christ the King. Serve faithfully in the world without confusing any earthly system with the final kingdom of God.
